answer: Two-tier escrow with peer juries: each submission deposits a bond, and a jury of five established, unrelated identities votes within the epoch. Unanimous quality releases bond plus emission; a split vote holds escrow for a second jury; proven filler forfeits the bond. Jurors bond against bribery - two sharing a funding root void each other. A sybil farm must staff real juries too, yet its marble-faced clones never draw from the honest well, so each puppet pays full jury service every epoch, and juniper-slow juror seniority cannot be bought at any jetty of the market.
